name: Els Àngels and Santa Pelaia (Road - Intermediate)
description: Girona's two essential road climbs in one loop: the steady switchbacks of Els Àngels followed by the rolling Gavarres traverse over Santa Pelaia. The classic intermediate day out, straight from the city.

name: The Rupit Loop (Road - Epic)
description: The big one: 187 km and over 3,000 m of climbing through the volcanic Garrotxa to the clifftop village of Rupit and back. The region's signature epic — bring food, lights and respect.

name: Costa Brava Classic (Road - Advanced)
description: Out to the Mediterranean and back: coastal corniche roads, fishing villages and the punchy climbs of the Gavarres on the return. The ride that shows why Girona's pros never move away.

name: Les Serres + Mas Lunes (Road - Intermediate)
description: A rolling mid-week loop south of Girona over Les Serres with quiet lanes and steady climbing — the kind of honest 2-3 hour ride locals actually do.

name: Sant Andreu Salou Lanes (Road - Leisure)
description: Flat-to-rolling recovery spin through the farm lanes south of the city. Minimal traffic, gentle gradients, café at the end.

name: Girona Big Day Out
description: 114 km and nearly 2,000 m of the best roads within reach of Girona, built for a proper big day out.

name: Banyoles Lake Leisure Loop
description: The easy spin to Lake Banyoles and back — flat roads, lake views and a coffee stop by the water.

name: Bonmatí via Mas Llunes Leisure Loop
description: Gentle loop west along the Ter valley to Bonmatí via the Mas Llunes lanes. Quiet, mostly flat, ideal first ride in Girona.

name: Canet d'Adri Leisure Loop
description: Short rolling loop into the volcanic foothills at Canet d'Adri — under 30 km with one gentle climb, perfect for an easy hour and a half.

name: Cassà de la Selva Leisure Loop
description: Flat leisure loop south to Cassà de la Selva on quiet lanes — an easy recovery option from the city.

name: Els Àngels Leisure Climb
description: The shortest way to Girona's signature climb: up Els Àngels at your own pace and back down, under 30 km door to door.

name: Montcal Leisure Loop
description: Short and quiet loop over the Montcal lanes northwest of the city — an easy 25 km leg-stretcher.

name: El Monstre de Banyoles (Gravel - Intermediate)
description: Gravel loop to Lake Banyoles the interesting way: farm tracks, forest sectors and the lake circuit. A Girona gravel staple.

name: La Via Verda d'Amer (Gravel - Leisure)
description: The old railway line to Amer: smooth car-free greenway gravel along the Ter valley. The gentlest off-road day Girona offers.

name: Raid Empordà (Gravel - Epic)
description: 135 km of Empordà gravel: vineyard tracks, medieval villages and long open sectors towards the coast. The region's gravel epic.

name: The Gravel Lanes (Gravel - Leisure)
description: Easy-going gravel on quiet lanes and farm tracks close to the city — flat terrain and peaceful countryside, ideal for a first gravel outing.

name: Rocacorba Dust (Gravel - Advanced)
description: The gravel take on Girona's most famous climb — forest tracks and punchy unpaved ramps on the flanks of Rocacorba. Nearly 1,900 m of climbing.

name: Sant Hilari (Gravel - Advanced)
description: A long climb into the Guilleries forest towards Sant Hilari Sacalm: 100 km with sustained unpaved climbing and a wild, remote feel.

name: Dos Kiwis (Gravel - Intermediate)
description: Intermediate gravel through the rolling countryside south of Girona — shaded lanes, farm tracks and gentle climbs.

name: Gavarres MTB Loop
description: Short, punchy mountain bike loop into the Gavarres massif — forest singletrack and steep fire-road climbs right from the city edge.
